sourceNote: Limitations questions reuse the existing source-reviewed bank unchanged. Additional multiple-choice questions are transformations of the existing source-linked drill actions and conditions. The original PDFs were not re-reviewed during this conversion; no new operational rules or company policy answers are inferred.

questions.question: Both engines have started for a two-engine taxi departure. What is the PF APU BLEED selection in the selected after-start flow?
options: OFF
ON until the taxi checklist
ON until takeoff thrust is set
AS REQUIRED only after takeoff
questions.explanation: The after-start PF flow selects APU BLEED OFF after both engines have started. Keep the complete procedure and its conditions in view.

questions.question: After both engines have started for a two-engine taxi departure, when does the selected PF flow call for the APU master to be switched OFF?
options: If the APU is not required
After every start, regardless of subsequent APU requirements
Only after the runway is vacated at destination
Only once the aircraft is airborne
questions.explanation: APU master OFF is conditional: the selected flow says to switch it off if the APU is not required.

questions.question: During the after-start flow, icing exists or is anticipated on the ground. What engine anti-ice selection is required by the sourced drill?
options: ON
OFF until takeoff thrust is applied
OFF until visible ice is detected
ON only after the aircraft is airborne
questions.explanation: The selected after-start action specifies engine anti-ice ON when icing exists or is anticipated on the ground.

questions.question: When taxiing in icing conditions with rain, slush or snow, what condition is retained in the selected after-start PM drill for flap selection?
options: Keep flaps retracted to the holding point
Select takeoff flaps immediately after the second engine starts
Extend flaps fully for the taxi
Select takeoff flaps before the aircraft starts moving
questions.explanation: The drill retains the source condition to keep the flaps retracted to the holding point when taxiing in icing conditions with rain, slush or snow.

questions.question: In the selected after-start PM flow, what is the pitch-trim wheel set to?
options: The takeoff CG setting
Neutral irrespective of takeoff CG
The landing CG setting
The last sector’s pitch-trim setting
questions.explanation: The pitch-trim wheel is set to the takeoff CG. This question covers the sourced cockpit action, not company loadsheet/LMC policy.

questions.question: After selecting takeoff flaps under the applicable conditions, where does the selected PM flow check flap position?
options: On the upper ECAM display
Only against the physical flap-lever position
On the flight plan page
On the rudder-trim indicator
questions.explanation: The selected flow calls for flap position to be checked on the upper ECAM display; lever selection is not the complete position check.

questions.question: In the selected after-start flow, STS appears during the ECAM status check. What is the specified follow-up?
options: Display the STATUS page
Clear STS without displaying STATUS
Reset the affected computer immediately
Defer the status check until after takeoff
questions.explanation: The sourced after-start action says to display the STATUS page if STS appears. It does not authorise a computer or circuit-breaker reset.

questions.question: What should the N/W steering disconnect memo show at the selected after-start PF check?
options: The memo should not be displayed
The memo should remain displayed throughout taxi
The memo should be displayed only above idle
The memo should flash during the check
questions.explanation: The selected PF action checks that the N/W steering disconnect memo is NOT DISPLAYED.

questions.question: At the selected after-start thrust-setting cross-check, which two sources are compared?
options: The E/WD thrust setting and FMS PERF
The E/WD thrust setting and the landing-gear page
The takeoff runway heading and rudder trim
The APU EGT and selected takeoff thrust
questions.explanation: The drill cross-checks the E/WD thrust setting against FMS PERF. This is one sourced cross-check, not the full departure-change procedure.

questions.question: The APU supplied air conditioning for takeoff. Which selected PM after-takeoff actions apply?
options: APU BLEED OFF, then APU master OFF
APU master OFF, with APU BLEED left ON
APU BLEED ON until cruise
Keep both selections unchanged until landing
questions.explanation: For this stated condition, the selected after-takeoff sequence has APU BLEED OFF followed by APU master OFF.

questions.question: During the selected after-takeoff flow, severe turbulence or heavy rain is encountered. Which engine-mode selector setting is specified?
options: IGN/START
NORM in all cases
CRANK
The setting is determined only by altitude
questions.explanation: The after-takeoff drill specifies IGN/START for severe turbulence or heavy rain as the applicable engine-mode selection.

questions.question: Takeoff was performed in TA-only. What TCAS selection is listed in the selected after-takeoff PM drill?
options: TA/RA or TFC, as applicable
Remain in TA-only until descent
STBY until above the transition altitude
OFF until clear of departure traffic
questions.explanation: The sourced after-takeoff action is TA/RA or TFC if takeoff was performed in TA-only. Use the applicable installed equipment and full procedure.

questions.question: Which exception accompanies engine anti-ice ON for existing or anticipated icing in the selected after-takeoff drill?
options: During climb and cruise with SAT below −40°C
During any phase with TAT below 0°C
During descent with SAT below −40°C
Whenever the aircraft is above the transition altitude
questions.explanation: The retained exception is climb and cruise with SAT below −40°C. Keep both the phase and the temperature reference with the rule.

questions.question: What wing anti-ice requirement is retained in the selected after-takeoff drill when there is evidence of ice accretion?
options: Wing anti-ice must be ON
Wing anti-ice is prohibited until landing
Wing anti-ice remains OFF unless both engines are at idle
Wing anti-ice is used only on the ground
questions.explanation: The drill states that wing anti-ice must be ON when there is evidence of ice accretion; it may also be used for prevention in icing conditions. Refer to the source criteria.

questions.question: When does the selected after-landing PF control drill begin?
options: After vacating the runway
Immediately after the main wheels touch down
As soon as reverse thrust is selected
Whenever the aircraft decelerates below taxi speed
questions.explanation: The sourced drill begins after the runway is vacated. It is a selected PF control subset, not the complete after-landing procedure.

questions.question: During the selected after-landing PF sequence, what strobe-light selection applies when crossing a runway?
options: ON
AUTO in all ground circumstances
OFF
The landing-light switch determines the strobe selection
questions.explanation: The retained instruction is AUTO when leaving the runway and ON when crossing a runway.

questions.question: What nose-light selection is listed in the selected PF flow when leaving the runway?
options: TAXI
TO
OFF until parked
No change from the approach setting
questions.explanation: The selected after-landing PF action is nose light TAXI when leaving the runway.

questions.question: During parking, accumulator pressure is low. What condition does the selected PF drill require before engine 1 shutdown?
options: Chocks must be in place
The landing lights must be retracted
The APU must be shut down
The flight-control check must be repeated
questions.explanation: The source-linked parking step requires chocks before engine 1 shutdown if accumulator pressure is low.
questions.ref: Normal procedures · Parking — PF selected actions

questions.question: With brake fans ON, above what indicated brake temperature does the parking drill say to avoid applying the parking brake unless operationally necessary?
questions.explanation: The retained parking condition is above 350°C with brake fans ON. The qualification “unless operationally necessary” is part of the sourced instruction.
questions.ref: Normal procedures · Parking — PF selected actions

questions.question: With brake fans OFF, above what brake temperature does the selected parking step say to avoid applying the parking brake unless operationally necessary?
questions.explanation: The source-linked parking step states above 500°C, or above 350°C with brake fans ON, unless operationally necessary.
questions.ref: Normal procedures · Parking — PF selected actions

questions.question: In the selected parking brake-pressure check, when may the pedals be released?
options: Once both needles are above the green area
As soon as the parking-brake handle is ON
Once either needle enters the green band
Only after the batteries have been switched OFF
questions.explanation: The retained parking action says to hold the pedals until both brake-pressure needles are above the green area.
questions.ref: Normal procedures · Parking — PF selected actions

questions.question: The yellow electric pump was used for one-engine taxi. What does the selected parking drill require before engine 1 shutdown?
options: Select the yellow electric pump OFF
Leave the yellow electric pump ON until the batteries are OFF
Select the blue electric pump ON instead
Cycle the yellow electric pump after engine 1 stops
questions.explanation: The sourced parking step is yellow electric pump OFF before engine 1 shutdown when it was used for one-engine taxi.
questions.ref: Normal procedures · Parking — PF selected actions

questions.question: No APU is being used during parking. What electrical-supply sequence is retained before engine shutdown?
options: Check EXT PWR AVAIL, then select external power ON
Select external power ON without checking availability
Shut down both engines, then check for external power
Switch both batteries OFF before selecting external power
questions.explanation: With no APU, the selected parking drill checks EXT PWR AVAIL and then selects it ON. If the APU is used, it checks APU AVAIL instead.
questions.ref: Normal procedures · Parking — PF selected actions

questions.question: The APU is being used as the parking electrical source. Which availability check is listed before engine shutdown?
options: APU AVAIL
APU master switch position alone
EXT PWR AVAIL regardless of APU use
Battery voltage alone
questions.explanation: The source-linked parking step checks APU AVAIL when the APU is used; master-switch position alone is not the cited availability check.
questions.ref: Normal procedures · Parking — PF selected actions

questions.question: What minimum interval after high-thrust operations is retained for selecting the engine masters OFF in the parking drill?
options: 3 minutes
30 seconds
1 minute
5 minutes
questions.explanation: The selected parking action is engine masters OFF no less than 3 minutes after high-thrust operations.
questions.ref: Normal procedures · Parking — PF selected actions

questions.question: During the selected parking sequence, when is the beacon switched OFF?
options: When all engines are below approximately 20% N2
As soon as the first engine master is selected OFF
When either engine falls below 20% N1
When the parking brake is first applied
questions.explanation: The retained condition is all engines below approximately 20% N2. Keep the parameter and the requirement for all engines with the action.
questions.ref: Normal procedures · Parking — PF selected actions

questions.question: In the selected securing sequence, which crew-role label is assigned to switching crew oxygen supply OFF?
options: CM2
PF regardless of seat
PM regardless of seat
CM1
questions.explanation: The source-linked securing drill assigns this action to CM2. The trainer retains the printed seat role rather than substituting PF or PM.

questions.question: What condition is retained for APU master OFF in the selected CM2 securing drill?
options: All passengers/supernumeraries have disembarked
The first engine has been shut down
The taxi checklist is complete
The aircraft has just vacated the runway
questions.explanation: The selected securing action says APU master OFF after all passengers/supernumeraries have disembarked. Apply the full procedure and its other conditions.

questions.question: Before switching batteries 1 and 2 OFF during securing, what APU-related condition must be met in the sourced drill?
options: The APU flap is fully closed
The APU master has just been selected OFF
APU AVAIL has just gone out, with no further wait
The APU BLEED switch is OFF
questions.explanation: The batteries are switched OFF only after the APU flap is fully closed, about 2 minutes after APU AVAIL goes out.

questions.question: How much time after ADIRS shutdown does the selected securing drill retain before electrical power is switched off?
options: At least 10 seconds
No delay is required
At least 60 seconds
Exactly 2 minutes after APU AVAIL
questions.explanation: The drill scope retains at least 10 seconds after ADIRS shutdown before electrical power OFF. This is separate from the APU-flap condition for battery shutdown.

questions.question: Following an engine shutdown longer than 2 hours, what warm-up condition is retained in the after-start drill before high power?
options: At least 5 minutes at idle or near idle; taxi time at idle may count
At least 3 minutes after the parking brake is released
At least 30 seconds once AVAIL appears
Five minutes airborne before climb thrust
questions.explanation: The sourced drill scope requires at least 5 minutes at idle or near idle after a shutdown longer than 2 hours. Taxi time at idle may count.
